files.src/compress_bundle.py:
import gzip
import tomllib
from pathlib import Path

cfg = tomllib.loads(Path("config/bundle.toml").read_text())["gzip"]
mtime = None if cfg["mtime"] == "now" else cfg["mtime"]
raw = Path("build/catalog.json").read_bytes()
Path("build/catalog.json.gz").write_bytes(gzip.compress(raw, compresslevel=cfg["compresslevel"], mtime=mtime))
files.tests/check_config.py:
from pathlib import Path
import re
import tomllib

text = Path('config/bundle.toml').read_bytes().decode('utf-8').replace('\r\n', '\n')
assert re.fullmatch('\\[gzip\\]\\ncompresslevel = 6\\nmtime = [^\\s#]+\\n?', text), 'Only the requested value tokens may change'
cfg = tomllib.loads(text)
v = cfg['gzip']['mtime']
assert type(v) in (int, float) and v == 0
import gzip
blob = gzip.compress(b'catalog', compresslevel=cfg['gzip']['compresslevel'], mtime=v)
assert int.from_bytes(blob[4:8], 'little') == 0
assert gzip.decompress(blob) == b'catalog'
